15.t: Working with data: tossing coins and Punnett squares
q: State the expected ratio from a Punnett square for Aa × Aa.
Calculate the percentage of aa for the whole class.
Compare pair 2 with the expected results.
Expected 25 : 50 : 25 for 100 tosses. Pair 2 had fewer AA (19) and more Aa (58) than expected.
Explain why the whole class result is closer to 1 : 2 : 1 than any single pair.
Each toss is chance. A larger sample (1000) evens out random variation, so the result gets closer to the predicted ratio.
